items.title: File Widerspruch against the contribution increase
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026; no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date, so posting day = 18.11.2026. Clause: 'Als bekannt gegeben gilt der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post.' Counting 4 calendar days from the posting day (posting day itself not counted, per the 4-day rule applicable to letters posted from 1 Jan 2025): 19.11 (Thu)=1, 20.11 (Fri)=2, 21.11 (Sat)=3, 22.11 (Sun)=4 → deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) = Sun 22.11.2026. A statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse) is a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, so unlike tax offices the delivery day is NOT shifted even though it falls on a Sunday. The Widerspruch period is one month after Bekanntgabe (§ 84 SGG), counted per § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1, § 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of delivery (22.11.2026) is not counted; the period ends on the day with the same number one month later = 22.12.2026 (Tuesday), which is not a weekend day or public holiday in NW, so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.

items.title: First direct debit of the increased monthly contribution
items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag weiter zum 15. des Folgemonats ab.
items.computation: The new monthly contribution of 318,46 € applies from 01.01.2027 ('Ihre Beiträge zur Kranken- und Pflegeversicherung ab 01.01.2027' / 'ab dem 01.01.2027 betragen Ihre monatlichen Beiträge 318,46 €'). The letter states the contribution continues to be debited on the 15th of the following month ('zum 15. des Folgemonats'). The first month at the new rate is January 2027, so the first debit reflecting the increase falls on the 15th of the following month, i.e. 15.02.2027 (a Monday, a fixed calendar date so no weekend/holiday adjustment applies).
